messages:
clara: quick sync — we need to cut over telemetry/events to a partitioned layout so per-route quota math is O(1) not huge joins. thinking schema: add route_service_id (varchar), bucket_ts (date) and move older rows to archive table.

diego: sounds necessary. what's the plan to keep console dashboards working during backfill?

clara: two-phase: 1) write-path dual-write to new columns + keep old payload. 2) backfill on a rolling job that writes to new partitions and verifies counts. dashboards read via an adapter that prefers new fields when present.

ben: dual-write is fine but we need a way to detect partial writes for canary tenants. suggestion: add a write_version integer on the row and expose it in telemetry.

alice: +1 to write_version. also we should add a small sample of SQL that the backfill job will run so infra can estimate runtime.

clara: example backfill snippet: 
```sql
INSERT INTO telemetry.events_new (id, route_service_id, bucket_ts, payload)
SELECT id, json_extract_scalar(payload, '$.route') as route_service_id, date_trunc('day', ts) as bucket_ts, payload
FROM telemetry.events
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '90 days'
AND write_version IS NULL;
```

edda: lock contention worries me. that INSERT will create lots of WAL and could bloat indexes. we should throttle and do chunked id ranges. also plan for index rebuilds.

diego: agree. we can run the backfill worker with concurrency=4 and do id chunks of 100k. also maintain a progress table to resume.

ben: on the read side, consoles need stable counts. propose read adapter behavior: if any row has write_version >= cutover_version, prefer counts from events_new; otherwise fallback to old table. we can expose a header X-Telemetry-Schema: new|legacy in the internal API for debug.

alice: UX note — product wants no visible gap in quota windows. we need a QA plan: compare aggregate per-route counts for last 30 days during dry-run and flag >0.5% variance.

clara: noted. also adding canary: enable dual-write for 10% tenants first, monitor token spend + dashboard diffs, then ramp. can we get a canary toggle in feature flags?

edda: migrate-bot can flip flags if we give it a list; I'll coordinate. also will add an alert that fires if backfill lag > 6 hours.

migrate-bot: scheduled job created: telemetry-backfill-worker v1. Params: chunk_size=100000, concurrency=4, dry_run=true. First run: 2024-06-11T02:00Z.

diego: operational checklist incoming. items: DB maintenance window? index creations? read adapter rollout? dashboard smoke tests?

clara: drafting checklist now — will post GDoc with precise SQLs and rollback steps. main rollback: stop dual-write, switch adapter to legacy, and rehydrate any partial writes from events table.

ben: one more: make sure billing & quota pipelines (batch jobs) are updated to read bucket_ts. otherwise we'll undercount. checklist must include all downstream consumers.

alice: agreed. can we set a cross-team review on Thurs? product + billing + infra.

clara: pinged calendar, Thurs 16:00 PT. thanks all — I'll upload the doc and the initial cutover timeline after the meeting.
